actions.defer: No inspection or restoration; retain the state leaf.
actions.escalate: Permitted request; timely authorized follow-through fraction times success on the off state; no disturbance to the on state in v1.
actions.direct: Use only if independently authorized, timely, and within the person-time cap.
actions.inspect: Unresolved or reported on: defer. Reported off: attempt only with independent authorization and before-deadline completion feasibility; unsuccessful or blocked outcomes retain the off leaf.

units.gap: B1 zero-power duration difference in seconds of the SAME auxiliary load, never pooled
units.check_charge: Dimensionless fraction k of each load gap: required same-unit advantage; not a measured extra interruption or a conversion of cooling service or labor.
units.disturbance: Extra zero-power seconds on already-on branches, as a fraction of the same load gap; synthetic only and at most the gap.
units.person: Person-time / declared person-time cap; every declared branch must fit, equality allowed. Expected consumption is recorded separately.
units.time: Elapsed / available pre-cut time; completion must be strictly before the cutoff. Check extra time includes arrival, verification and reporting; no credit for late completion in this model.

frozen_spec.observation_basis: Sensitivity/specificity are conditional on a resolved report; state-specific unresolved probabilities are positive. All parameters are declared synthetic axes, not field estimates.
frozen_spec.success_basis: For an off state, q is conditional success after a timely authorized attempt. Success is stipulated to use the B1 on leaf. Failure, refusal, unresolved report and missed deadline retain the off leaf; their lost benefit is not charged again.
frozen_spec.comparison: For each auxiliary separately: strictly beat every eligible no-inspection comparator after the same-unit hurdle. Tie, loss and ineligibility are distinct. Nothing is added to the main service measure.

local_controller.boundary_mapping: same normalized p regions; multiply normalized advantage/charge by this asset gap
